findings: In `meaning_history.senses`, the current sense `坏:simplified-writing-of-壞` glosses 坏 as “bad, spoiled, ruined,” but the evidence IDs E7 and E17 provide those definitions for 坏 and 壞 records respectively; X-4351e30ba416ee437457 and X-96ab9555613ca002b772 distinguish 坏’s modern huài spelling function from its older lexical readings. Clarify that these meanings belong to the word written 壞, which modern standard 坏 spells, rather than attributing them to 坏’s older mound or pottery word. Apply the same distinction in the summary and learner overview, which currently attach “bad” or “ruined” directly to 坏.
